commands.text:
python -m pip install --upgrade build
python -m build

REF_NAME="$REF_NAME_RAW"
VERSION=${REF_NAME#v}
# F-a4d8291c: PyInstaller's --add-data separator is OS-specific (`;`
# on Windows, `:` elsewhere) -- this step runs under bash on every
# matrix leg via `shell: bash`, but PyInstaller itself is a native
# Windows Python process on windows-latest and parses the
# SRC<sep>DEST spec using the target OS's separator, not the
# invoking shell's.
if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
  DATA_SEP=";"
else
  DATA_SEP=":"
fi
# --no-sync: build from the base env created by `uv pip install .`
# above; do NOT re-resolve the project (which would drag in optional
# extras like [voice] -> voice-soundboard[kokoro] -> onnxruntime and
# bloat the binary). The binary ships the base game only; voice is
# pip-install-only via `escape-the-valley[voice]`.
#
# F-a4d8291c: --add-data bundles the two non-Python files the game
# needs at runtime that PyInstaller cannot discover on its own:
# tui.tcss (TrailApp.CSS_PATH) and data/event_skeletons.json (~200
# of the game's ~260 events -- event_loader.load_json_events()
# silently returns [] if this is missing, so an unbundled JSON
# ships a binary that starts cleanly and plays a quarter-game).
uv run --no-sync pyinstaller --onefile --name "${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}" --console \
  --collect-submodules rich \
  --collect-submodules textual \
  --collect-data textual \
  --add-data "src/escape_the_valley/tui.tcss${DATA_SEP}escape_the_valley" \
  --add-data "src/escape_the_valley/data/event_skeletons.json${DATA_SEP}escape_the_valley/data" \
  "${{ env.ENTRYPOINT }}"
OUTNAME="${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
mv "dist/${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}${{ matrix.ext }}" "dist/${OUTNAME}"
echo "ASSET_NAME=${OUTNAME}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

REF_NAME="$REF_NAME_RAW"
VERSION=${REF_NAME#v}
cd artifacts
sha256sum * > "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
cat "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"

commands.step: Install npm >=11.5 in a sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 ships npm 10.9, which signs Sigstore provenance but cannot
# negotiate the OIDC auth path for trusted publishing (the PUT returns
# a misleading 404 "not in this registry"). An in-place
# `npm install -g npm@latest` races on the bundled npm's arborist
# rebuild and breaks irrecoverably; a sandbox install + PATH shadow
# avoids the race. See memory: npm-115-required-for-oidc.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} -> ${TAG_VERSION} | package.json: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

PY_VERSION=$(python3 -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'])")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "pyproject.toml: ${PY_VERSION}"
if [ "${PY_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match pyproject.toml version ${PY_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

# Extract the `## [<version>] - ...` section from CHANGELOG.md as notes;
# fall back to the tag name if the section is missing.
VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
NOTES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
# Match the heading literally with index() — a dynamic regex with
# escaped brackets (\[ \]) is treated as a character class by some awk
# variants, which silently yields empty notes.
awk -v hdr="## [${VERSION}]" '
  index($0, hdr) == 1 {capture=1; next}
  capture && /^## / {exit}
  capture {print}
' CHANGELOG.md > "${NOTES_FILE}"

if [ ! -s "${NOTES_FILE}" ]; then
  echo "Escape the Valley ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" > "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "" >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "See CHANGELOG.md for details." >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
fi

# Idempotent: skip creation if the release already exists (re-pushed
# tag / workflow_dispatch re-run). Publishing the release lets the
# downstream workflow_run chain (publish.yml + release-binaries.yml) run.
if gh release view "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} already exists; skipping create."
else
  gh release create "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --title "Escape the Valley ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --notes-file "${NOTES_FILE}" \
    --verify-tag
fi

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC trusted publisher)
